collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — BEYOND THE HORIZON, EVENTS 081 to 130 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more speculative branching events continuing "Isola — Beyond the Horizon" (001-080), in the same format: EVENT nnn — TITLE, SETUP, choices A/B/C, two mutually exclusive outcomes per choice, and an optional "Content note:".

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: Taking a day off after a busy week, a villager wonders whether distant people have days set aside for rest.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Taking a day off after a busy week, (name1) wonders whether distant people have days set aside for rest.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The villager imagines everyone resting on the same day, the whole place quiet.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A busy farmer wonders who would feed the animals.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A scholar wonders whether some people might work without stopping.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: An elder says rest is not laziness, anywhere.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The villager spends the day in a hammock, without guilt.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The villager cannot stay still and ends up tidying, which is restful in its own way.
